sobre_desc: About Eu Vim de Santos and this site.
sobre_p1: {n} is the channel of {a} ({h}), journalist, with comments and analyses about Santos FC almost every day. This site is the calm version of the channel: full archive ({v} videos so far), search, transcripts and easy-to-share pages.
ed_lives: Lives: Trio Live, fire corridor and live streams.
how_p1: A robot checks the channel several times a day and updates the site automatically. Another robot transcribes videos in Portuguese, gradually, from newest to oldest. The transcripts come from YouTube auto captions or speech recognition and may have errors.
how_p2: No video is hosted here. The player is the YouTube player (cookie-free mode), so every view counts for the channel. The site doesn't use trackers or ads.
fol_p: New video almost every day on the YouTube channel; behind-the-scenes, opinion and daily updates with Felipe on Instagram and X.
legal_p: Fan site, no affiliation with Santos FC, YouTube or the channel. All videos, descriptions and quotes belong to their authors. If you are the owner of any content and want to remove it, open an issue in the repository and the content is removed on the next update.
bol_desc: Revised auto summaries of Eu Vim de Santos videos.
bol_intro: Auto summaries revised, one per video. The full text is on each video's page.
nf_p: This page doesn't exist (or the video was removed).
